**PATTERN 1: MRI Panic Override Truncating Winners (Negative)**

On 07-08, this forced the exit of **AVGO** (which was profitable and had already been pushed to breakeven) and locked in losses on **MS**, **SNOW**, **HOOD**, and **MARA**. This violates the Asness/Jegadeesh principles of letting winners run; the bot is truncating momentum continuation on assets that are demonstrating relative strength during market stress.

**PATTERN 2: Sub-Kelly Position Sizing & Capital Inefficiency (Negative)**
Despite a `MAX_RISK` of 4% (~$112 on a $2,800 account), the bot is consistently risking less than 1% on high-conviction (Score 12) setups.
